HAL.d: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited designs, develops, manufactures, and repairs aircraft, helicopters, aero-engines, and avionics. It is a state-owned enterprise supplying primarily to the Indian armed forces.

HAPPYFORGE.d: Happy Forgings Limited manufactures heavy forged and machined components for the automotive and industrial sectors. Its main customers include global commercial vehicle and equipment manufacturers.

HATSUN.d: Hatsun Agro Product processes and markets milk and dairy products under brands like Arun Icecreams and Arokya. It serves retail consumers directly through a wide distribution network.

HAVELLS.d: Havells India manufactures and sells a wide range of electrical equipment, including switchgear, cables, lighting, and consumer appliances. It serves residential, commercial, and industrial customers.

HCG.d: Healthcare Global Enterprises operates a specialized chain of cancer treatment hospitals across India. It provides comprehensive oncology care services, including radiation therapy, surgical oncology, and diagnostics.

HCLTECH.d: HCL Technologies provides software development, enterprise IT, and digital business services. It serves global corporate clients across multiple industry sectors.

HDBFS.d: HDB Financial Services provides consumer credit, asset finance, and business loans to retail and commercial customers across India. It operates as a non-banking financial company and a subsidiary of HDFC Bank.

HDFCAMC.d: HDFC Asset Management Company manages mutual funds and provides portfolio management services to institutional and retail investors. It is one of India's largest asset management companies.

HDFCBANK.d: HDFC Bank provides commercial banking services, retail loans, credit cards, and wealth management to individuals and corporate clients. It is India's largest private sector bank by assets.

HDFCLIFE.d: HDFC Life Insurance Company Limited offers individual and group life insurance and pension products to retail and corporate customers across India. It operates as a joint venture with HDFC Bank.

HEROMOTOCO.d: Hero MotoCorp manufactures motorcycles and scooters, holding the position of the largest two-wheeler manufacturer in India. It serves individual commuters and retail customers through an extensive domestic and international dealership network.

HEXT.d: Hexaware Technologies provides IT consulting, software development, and digital transformation services to global enterprises across various industries. It operates as a subsidiary of Carlyle Group.

HFCL.d: HFCL Limited manufactures telecommunication equipment and provides optical fiber cables and communication solutions. Its main customers are telecom service providers and defense enterprises.

HGS.ind: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)

HINDALCO.d: Hindalco Industries Limited produces primary aluminum, copper, and value-added aluminum products for packaging, construction, and electrical sectors. It is a flagship metals company of the Aditya Birla Group.

HINDCOPPER.d: Hindustan Copper Limited is a state-owned enterprise engaged in the mining and processing of copper ore in India. It produces copper cathode, wire bar, and continuous cast rod for industrial customers.

HINDPETRO.d: The company refines crude oil and markets petroleum products throughout India. It operates as a state-owned enterprise under the control of the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.

HINDUNILVR.d: Hindustan Unilever manufactures and sells fast-moving consumer goods, including home care, personal care, and food products. It serves mass-market consumers across India and is a subsidiary of Unilever.

HINDZINC.d: Hindustan Zinc Limited mines and smelts zinc, lead, and silver, primarily serving the steel, die-casting, and automotive industries. It is India's largest zinc producer and a subsidiary of Vedanta Limited.

HMT.d: HMT is a state-owned enterprise primarily engaged in the manufacturing of tractors and printing machinery. It serves agricultural and industrial customers across India.

HNDFDS.d: Hindustan Foods Limited is a contract manufacturer that produces diverse fast-moving consumer goods for major brand owners. It operates multiple manufacturing facilities across India.

HOMEFIRST.d: Home First Finance Company India Limited provides housing loans for the purchase and construction of homes. Its main customers are first-time homebuyers in the low and middle-income segments.

HONASA.d: Honasa Consumer develops and sells digital-first beauty and personal care brands such as Mamaearth. It markets its products directly to consumers through e-commerce and retail channels.

HONAUT.d: Honeywell Automation India provides integrated automation and software solutions for building and industrial processes. Its customers include commercial buildings, manufacturing plants, and utilities.

HSCL.d: Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited manufactures carbon black, coal tar pitch, and other specialty carbon compounds. Its products serve the lithium-ion battery, tyres, and specialty chemicals industries.

HUDCO.d: Housing & Urban Development Corporation Limited is a state-owned financial institution that provides long-term finance for housing and urban infrastructure projects across India. It primarily serves state governments, urban local bodies, and public agencies.

HYUNDAI.d: Hyundai Motor India Limited manufactures and sells passenger cars and utility vehicles in domestic and export markets. It is the second-largest passenger car manufacturer in India.
